verdict.rationale: Scheduled or monitored searches are a plausible feature for a search API, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Brave Search API offering recurring jobs, scheduled queries or workflow scheduling. The n8n and Dify integration guides point to external automation platforms, which are host-platform or user-side workarounds and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
